name: Basic Mathematics
subtitle: Algebra, Trigonometry, Coordinate Geometry & Differential Calculus
desc: Fundamental mathematics course covering algebra, determinants, matrices, trigonometry, coordinate geometry, and differential calculus for all engineering disciplines.

name: Communication Skills (English)
subtitle: Technical English, Business Correspondence, Grammar & Oral Communication
desc: Comprehensive English communication guide covering business letters, technical reports, grammar rules, vocabulary building, and professional speaking skills.

name: Basic Science (Physics & Chemistry)
subtitle: Units & Dimensions, SHM, Optics, Metals, Corrosion & Water Treatment
desc: Dual-subject curriculum: Basic Physics (measurement, SHM, light, lasers) and Basic Chemistry (water treatment, metals, alloys, corrosion, lubricants) with full lab manuals.

name: Computer Engineering Workshop Practice
subtitle: PC Assembly, Hardware Identification, RJ-45 LAN Cabling & OS Setup
desc: Hands-on computer hardware workshop covering PC components, RAM/motherboard installation, network cable crimping (T568A/B), BIOS configuration, and OS deployment.

name: Engineering Workshop Practice (Mechanical & Electrical)
subtitle: Fitting, Carpentry, Arc/Gas Welding, Sheet Metal & Electrical Wiring
desc: Traditional mechanical workshop practice covering precision fitting, wood joints, electric arc welding, sheet metal fabrication, and fundamental home wiring safety.

name: Electronics Engineering Workshop Practice
subtitle: Component Testing, Breadboard Prototyping, PCB Soldering & CRO Operation
desc: Practical electronics laboratory training covering component identification (resistors, diodes, ICs), breadboard circuits, soldering/desoldering, and multimeter testing.

name: Civil Engineering Workshop
subtitle: Brick Masonry Bonds, Plumbing Joints, Formwork Carpentry & Bar Bending
desc: Field civil construction workshop covering English/Flemish masonry bonds, GI & PVC plumbing pipe connections, timber shuttering joints, bar bending, and site safety.

name: Applied Mathematics
subtitle: Integral Calculus, Definite Integrals, Differential Equations & Numerical Methods
desc: Advanced mathematics for engineering: integration techniques, definite integrals, area/volume calculations, first-order differential equations, and probability distributions.

name: Basic Electrical & Electronics Engineering
subtitle: AC/DC Fundamentals, Magnetic Circuits, Diodes, Transistors & Logic Gates
desc: Essential electrical circuits, electromagnetic induction, single-phase AC concepts, transformer basics, PN junction diodes, rectifiers, and fundamental logic circuits.

name: Programming in C
subtitle: Algorithms, Control Flow, Arrays, Strings, Functions, Pointers & File I/O
desc: Comprehensive structured programming guide in C covering loops, conditional branching, 1D/2D arrays, functions, pointers, structures, unions, and file handling.

name: Linux Basics
subtitle: Linux Shell Commands, File Permissions, Process Management & Shell Scripting
desc: Operating system command-line fundamentals: Unix/Linux directory hierarchy, file manipulation, grep/sed, user administration, package management, and bash shell scripts.

name: Professional Communication
subtitle: Presentation Skills, Resume Writing, Group Discussions & Corporate Etiquette
desc: Workplace communication training: mock interviews, technical presentations, email drafting, meeting minutes, and corporate professional ethics.

name: Web Page Designing
subtitle: HTML5, CSS3, Responsive Web Layouts, Bootstrap & JavaScript Basics
desc: Frontend web development foundations: semantic HTML5 tags, CSS flexbox/grid styling, responsive forms, navigation bars, and basic client-side JavaScript.

name: Basic Mechanical Engineering
subtitle: Thermodynamics, IC Engines, Power Transmission, Boilers & Pumps
desc: Core mechanical engineering principles: heat engines, steam generators, pumps, air compressors, belt/gear power transmission, and manufacturing processes.

name: Applied Science (Physics & Chemistry)
subtitle: Wave Motion, Photoelectricity, Non-destructive Testing, Electrochemistry & Fuels
desc: Applied science for core engineering: sound waves, ultrasonic testing, photocells, nanotechnology, galvanic cells, battery technologies, and industrial fuel combustion.

name: Elements of Electronics
subtitle: Semiconductor Diodes, BJT Amplifiers, JFET, MOSFET & Regulated Power Supplies
desc: Electronic devices and circuits: semiconductor physics, zener regulators, transistor biasing, small-signal CE amplifiers, FET characteristics, and power supply design.

name: Fundamental of Electrical Engineering
subtitle: DC Circuits, Network Theorems, Electromagnetism, AC Waveforms & Polyphase Circuits
desc: Cornerstone course for electrical engineers: Ohm's & Kirchhoff's laws, superposition/Thevenin theorems, magnetic circuits, sinusoidal AC analysis, and 3-phase star/delta systems.

name: Engineering Drawing
subtitle: Orthographic Projections, Isometric Views, Sections of Solids & AutoCAD
desc: Technical visualization and drafting: lines, scales, engineering curves, orthographic multiview projection, isometric drawings, sectional views, and 2D computer-aided drafting.

name: Engineering Mechanics
subtitle: Coplanar Force Systems, Equilibrium, Friction, Centroid, Moment of Inertia & Kinetics
desc: Statics and dynamics fundamentals: resultant of force systems, Lami's theorem, beam reactions, laws of friction, center of gravity, Newton's laws, work-energy, and impulse.

name: Basic Electronics
subtitle: Diodes, Transistor Characteristics, Operational Amplifiers & Digital Gates
desc: Introduction to analog and digital electronic circuits: diode clippers/clampers, bipolar transistors, op-amp configurations (inverting/non-inverting), and Boolean logic gates.

name: Elements of Electrical Engineering
subtitle: Electrical Circuits, AC Machines, Transformers, Measuring Meters & Safety
desc: Electrical foundation for electronics students: magnetic circuits, single-phase transformers, DC motors, induction motors, wattmeters, earthing, and electrical safety devices.

name: Electronic Materials & Components
subtitle: Dielectric, Magnetic, Semiconductor Materials, Passive Components & PCB Tech
desc: Material science for electronics: conductors, insulators, magnetic ferrites, SMD resistors, multilayer capacitors, inductors, relays, switches, and PCB fabrication steps.

name: Building Material & Construction
subtitle: Stones, Bricks, Cement, Mortar, Concrete, Masonry & Building Substructure
desc: Civil engineering construction materials: physical properties and tests for bricks, cement, aggregates, concrete mix design, foundations, masonry walls, damp proofing, and doors/windows.

name: Surveying
subtitle: Chain Surveying, Compass Traversing, Leveling, Contouring & Plane Table
desc: Fundamental geospatial measurement techniques: linear measurements, prismatic compass surveying, local attraction corrections, Dumpy level operations, differential leveling, and contour plotting.

name: Fundamental of Chemical Engineering & Materials
subtitle: Unit Operations, Material Balances, Stoichiometry, Fluid Properties & Corrosion
desc: Introduction to process engineering: classification of chemical process operations, mass conservation equations, ideal gas laws, fluid viscosity, and material selection for corrosive environments.

name: Solid Fluid Operations
subtitle: Particle Sizing, Filtration, Sedimentation, Agitation, Fluid Flow & Fluidization
desc: Mechanical operations in chemical technology: screen analysis, ball mills, plate and frame filter press, thickeners, cyclones, mixing equipment, and fluidization dynamics.
